import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Revenue by Product (Top subplot-left)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
product_revenue.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=colors[:len(product_revenue)])
ax1.set_title('Total Revenue by Product', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
for container in ax1.containers:
    ax1.bar_label(container, fmt='$%.0f', padding=3, fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales Distribution by Customer Age Group and Payment Method (Top subplot-right)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_payment = df.groupby(['customer_age_group', 'payment_method'])['total'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_payment = age_payment.reindex([a for a in age_order if a in age_payment.index])
age_payment.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax2, colormap='Set2')
ax2.set_title('Revenue by Age Group and Payment Method', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.set_xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax2.legend(title='Payment Method', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9, loc='upper left')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Size Preference Distribution (Bottom subplot-left)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
size_counts = df['size'].value_counts()
colors_pie = sns.color_palette("pastel", len(size_counts))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(size_counts.values, labels=size_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, 
                                     colors=colors_pie, textprops={'fontsize': 11})
ax3.set_title('Size Preference Distribution', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
for text in texts:
    text.set_fontsize(11)
    text.set_fontweight('bold')

# 4. Average Transaction Value by Hour and Takeaway Status (Bottom subplot-right)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time'], format='%H:%M').dt.hour
hourly_takeaway = df.groupby(['hour', 'is_takeaway'])['total'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
hourly_takeaway.plot(ax=ax4, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, markersize=6)
ax4.set_title('Average Transaction Value by Hour', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(['Dine-in', 'Takeaway'], title='Order Type', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=10)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
ax4.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))
ax4.set_xlim(-0.5, 23.5)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
